verdict.rationale: Lovable's official MCP server lets an AI agent create projects, send build prompts, inspect code, and deploy apps programmatically, so the core of generating and managing apps from code is covered. However, the only thing branded "Lovable API" is Build with URL, which just produces prefilled-prompt links, and probes for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec all returned 404. That means there is no evidenced general-purpose REST platform API. Missing for 10: documented REST/HTTP platform API with an OpenAPI spec, API authentication/key management docs, programmatic project lifecycle beyond MCP (list/delete/settings), independent hands-on corroboration.
